g.text: Zephyr event contracts: copy, transfer, or schedule?
C · k_work: schedule a handler, not one payload per submit
Z5 · Representative static/bounded choices · no automatic safety for arbitrary owning Rust values
k_poll() only reports readiness of supported kernel objects. Acquire/dequeue afterward, handle races, and reset poll state.
BLUE solid = API call | TEAL solid = data / ownership | ORANGE dashed = wake / schedule | GREY dotted = build / configuration

text.tspan: copy into ring or waiting receiver
no payload copy; no fixed capacity
use a bounded pool for a limit
